overloads.semanticRole: Returns the number of items in a hierarchical list, either just the currently visible/expanded ones or the total including collapsed sublists.

interactionNotes.note: The leading '*' selects how 'list' is interpreted: passed = list is an object name (Text) identifying a form representation of the list; omitted = list is a ListRef (Integer). The trailing '*' selects what is counted: passed = total item count regardless of expand/collapse state; omitted = only currently visible items, which requires the object-name form if multiple representations of the same list exist in the form.

constraints: If several form objects reference the same list by name and the '@' wildcard is used in an object name match, the command applies only to the first matching object.
